verdict.rationale: Docusign's official MCP connector and server let an agent query agreement status and key dates, retrieve agreement metadata, and trigger IAM workflow actions. Together these give an agent the core building blocks to watch deadlines and act on them through first-party APIs. However, nothing documents renewal-specific tracking, deadline alerts, or proactive notifications, so the monitoring loop itself is only implied. Missing for 10: documented renewal/expiration date tracking, deadline alerts or event callbacks an agent can subscribe to, explicit renewal or extension actions, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven renewal monitoring.
